taskVersion.name: ves-heldout-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station H-04 (survey area H). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 133.9 | 19.46 | 19.46
2 | 50.7 | 19.69 | 39.15
3 | 23.0 | 4.00 | 43.15
4 | 61.9 | 4.32 | 47.47
5 | 20.8 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as QHA-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: H-04
Curve type: QHA
Aquifer depth: 39.15 m – 43.15 m (secondary, thin low-resistivity zone) and >47.47 m (main target, low-resistivity basal layer, ρ = 20.8 Ω·m)
Recommendation: Plan the borehole to penetrate past 47.47 m to intersect the deep, low-resistivity layer 5, which is the most promising water-bearing horizon; log carefully through the thin conductive zone at 39–43 m as it may represent a secondary or perched aquifer worth testing during drilling.
